payload.description_html: Close-up views of dinosaur gastroliths (A–D). A, Haya griva (IGM 100/2015); B, Archaeorhynchus spathula (IVPP V17091); C, Tarbosaurus bataar (MPC-D 552-1); D, close-up of gastrolith mass showing the red boxed region of C. Red arrowheads are pointing to the major (not all) gastroliths in the abdominal cavity. E, The five categories used to characterize gastrolith shape, redrawn from Best and Gionfriddo (1991).
